svg.title: Canon 5D Mark III sensor readout modes
svg.desc: Three drawings of the 5760 x 3840 sensor at the same scale. 3x3 binning reads the whole sensor and groups each 3 by 3 block of photosites into one pixel: 1920 x 1280, crop factor 1x, minimal aliasing. 1x3 binning reads every line and groups three columns into one pixel, so the image is squeezed horizontally and is stretched three times in post; the 5.7K preset reads an area of about 5425 x 2300, crop factor about 1.06x, no line skipping. 1:1 crop reads every photosite of a 1920 x 1080 window at the centre: crop factor 3x, no aliasing.
svg.text: Canon 5D Mark III sensor: three ways to read it for video
Each outline is the full sensor, 5760 x 3840 photosites, drawn to scale. Filled area = photosites read.
Each 3 x 3 block becomes one pixel
stretch x3 in post to about 5425 x 2300
Area read: a window at the centre
Recorded sizes and aliasing as listed in chapter 02; crop factors computed from photosite counts. The 5.7K area is approximate.
